description: Build the evidence matrix artifact and plot independent experimental support per proposed Mdh2 location against stress-dependence and current GO status
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Evidence matrix assembled from checks run in iterations 1-2 (all entries traceable to a tool call)
ev = pd.DataFrame([
 dict(citation="PMID:1986231", evidence_type="localization (direct assay)", stance="qualifies",
      claim="Steady-state location of Mdh2",
      finding="Mdh2 assigned to the cytosol; basis of GO:0005829 IDA",
      context="S. cerevisiae, cell fractionation, unstressed",
      confidence="High for cytosol; says nothing about stress conditions"),
 dict(citation="PMID:11914276", evidence_type="localization (high-throughput)", stance="qualifies",
      claim="Steady-state location of Mdh2",
      finding="Cytoplasm; basis of GO:0005737 HDA",
      context="S. cerevisiae epitope-tagged proteome survey, unstressed",
      confidence="Moderate; HDA, no subnuclear resolution"),
 dict(citation="PMID:25817432", evidence_type="localization (imaging screen)", stance="supports (conditionally)",
      claim="Mdh2 is at the nuclear periphery",
      finding="Sole source of GO:0034399 IDA. Mdh2-GFP scored as an MG132-induced perinuclear focus co-localizing with Cmr1 in a 4800-strain screen; 27 hits total; paper states only 18/27 are nuclear without stress",
      context="S. cerevisiae, GFP collection, proteasome inhibition (MG132) and MMS; Mdh2 named only in supplementary data",
      confidence="Low-moderate for native localization; the compartment is defined as a sequestration site for misfolded, ubiquitylated and sumoylated protein"),
 dict(citation="PMID:33177075", evidence_type="localization + interaction (direct assay)", stance="competing",
      claim="Mdh2 has a second location besides cytosol",
      finding="Mdh2 dually localized cytosol and peroxisome, imported by association with Mdh3 and Pex5-dependent piggybacking",
      context="S. cerevisiae, targeted imaging, genetics, split-fluorophore reporters",
      confidence="High; mechanism identified; absent from GO for MDH2"),
 dict(citation="PMID:7673155", evidence_type="mutant phenotype / structural", stance="qualifies",
      claim="Mdh2 N-terminal 12-residue extension is a targeting signal",
      finding="The 12-residue Mdh2 N-terminal extension is a catabolite-inactivation determinant, not a targeting signal; Mdh3 PTS1 deletion relocates Mdh3 to the cytosol",
      context="S. cerevisiae, chimeric MDH constructs",
      confidence="High; directly refutes any targeting role for the Mdh2 N-terminus"),
 dict(citation="PMID:28126757", evidence_type="direct assay / mutant phenotype", stance="competing (mechanism)",
      claim="Why proteasome inhibition would concentrate Mdh2 in a deposit",
      finding="Mdh2 bears a Pro/N-degron (UniProt motif 2-5) and is targeted for proteasomal degradation on shift to glucose",
      context="S. cerevisiae, GID/Pro-N-end-rule pathway",
      confidence="High; makes Mdh2 an expected client of a quality-control deposit when the proteasome is blocked"),
 dict(citation="QuickGO/SGD REST audit (this work)", evidence_type="computational (database audit)", stance="qualifies",
      claim="How much independent support does nuclear periphery have",
      finding="GO:0034399 on P22133 is a single IDA line, qualifier located_in, no With/From, no annotation extension, assigned by SGD 2016-01-08; all 28 GO:0034399 IDAs citing PMID:25817432 are the same INQ batch and include Qcr6 (mitochondrial) and Pir1 (cell wall); GO:0070013 IEA is an ARBA propagation of that one IDA",
      context="QuickGO annotation and GAF endpoints, SGD backend, 2026-11",
      confidence="High; direct database records"),
 dict(citation="UniProt sequence analysis (this work)", evidence_type="computational (sequence)", stance="refutes (autonomous targeting)",
      claim="Mdh2 carries an organelle targeting signal",
      finding="No PTS1 (C-term ASS vs Mdh3 SKL), no PTS2, no mitochondrial presequence (N25 net charge -1, 2 acidic, moment 0.21 vs Mdh1 +4, 0 acidic, 0.58 with annotated transit peptide), no mono- or bipartite NLS; Mdh2-GFP ~68 kDa monomer exceeds the ~40 kDa passive pore limit",
      context="P17505 / P22133 / P32419, computed from UniProt REST",
      confidence="High for absence of classical signals; motif scans cannot exclude non-canonical import"),
])
ev.to_csv("mdh2_nuclear_periphery_evidence_matrix.csv", index=False)
pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",70); pd.set_option("display.width",300)
print(ev[["citation","evidence_type","stance"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\nsaved mdh2_nuclear_periphery_evidence_matrix.csv")

# --- figure: independent experimental support per proposed location, and the condition required ---
loc = pd.DataFrame([
 dict(location="cytosol / cytoplasm", n_indep_exp_refs=2, requires_stress=0, in_GO=1,
      refs="PMID:1986231 (IDA), PMID:11914276 (HDA)"),
 dict(location="peroxisome", n_indep_exp_refs=2, requires_stress=0, in_GO=0,
      refs="PMID:33177075 (IDA+mechanism), PMID:19118449 (IMP, BP term)"),
 dict(location="nuclear periphery (INQ)", n_indep_exp_refs=1, requires_stress=1, in_GO=1,
      refs="PMID:25817432 (IDA, MG132/MMS only)"),
])
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
c=["#4C78A8","#54A24B","#E45756"]
axes[0].barh(loc.location, loc.n_indep_exp_refs, color=c)
axes[0].set_xlabel("independent experimental references in the literature")
axes[0].set_xticks([0,1,2]); axes[0].invert_yaxis()
axes[0].set_title("Experimental support per proposed Mdh2 location")
for i,r in loc.iterrows():
    axes[0].text(r.n_indep_exp_refs+0.04, i, r.refs, va="center", fontsize=7.5)
axes[0].set_xlim(0,3.4)

m=loc[["requires_stress","in_GO"]].values.T
axes[1].imshow(m, cmap="RdYlGn_r", vmin=0, vmax=1, aspect="auto")
axes[1].set_xticks(range(3)); axes[1].set_xticklabels(loc.location, fontsize=8, rotation=12)
axes[1].set_yticks([0,1]); axes[1].set_yticklabels(["needs proteotoxic\nstress to be seen","currently a CC term\nin GO for MDH2"], fontsize=8)
for y in range(2):
    for x in range(3):
        axes[1].text(x,y,"yes" if m[y,x] else "no", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10, fontweight="bold")
axes[1].set_title("The term GO carries is the stress-conditional one;\nthe mechanistically explained peroxisomal location is missing", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
